classification: same-revision owned/source-backed lifecycle baseline; no optimization claim
isolation: fresh process per lane/corpus/role/repeat; task CPU workloads serialized; shared host background uncontrolled
sink: Both roles reserve the same bounded sink before measurement: maximum 2 * owned baseline output bytes + 65536, write chunk 65536 bytes. Source output must fit.
source_boundary: Input Vec clones, in-memory instrumented ReadAt adapters, sink construction/reservation outside. Both from_read_at constructors, public plan and publication inside. Read counters reset before opening; no selected-slide cache warming. Reopen, independent preservation/semantic oracles and destruction outside.
owned_boundary: Input Vec clones and sink construction/reservation outside. Both Package::from_vec constructors, opened snapshots, plan, commit and publication inside. Reopen, independent preservation/semantic oracles and destruction outside.
hypothesis: The two current public APIs can perform the same admitted plain/eight-image slide-copy workload with matching source and destination bytes, selectors, collision pattern and preservation contract. Their internal phase and retained-artifact boundaries differ.
acceptance: Strict report schema and sample ordering, source/binary/protocol custody, common inputs/sink ceilings, stable per-role output digest, independent media/relationship/content-type/raw-destination preservation and source/refusal gates. All focused correctness tests pass.
claims: Current per-role normal distributions, allocation vectors, logical read/write behavior and within-role repeat stability only. No source-backed speedup, memory reduction, prior-version delta, zero-copy, physical-I/O or post-drop retention claim. Normal/allocator elapsed values are not compared.
limits: In-memory Vec-backed ReadAt includes adapter read-counter overhead. V3 allocator callback-order metrics include pre-existing live bytes and any background callbacks; observer mutex perturbs scheduling. Retained plans and other objects are alive at exit. Whole-process time-v RSS includes setup, validation and teardown. Shared-host drift may withhold acceptance-grade distributions.
excluded_from_formal_matrix: Functional one-sample zero-warmup selector checks. No heaptrack capture in this batch; explicit stage/drop memory snapshots and native/cold/range/scaling evidence remain follow-up work.
